import hashlib, hmac, json
from pathlib import Path
sha = [(n, hashlib.sha256(bytes(i % 251 for i in range(n))).hexdigest())
       for n in [0,1,7,31,55,56,63,64,65,119,120,127,128,129,257,1024]]
message = bytes(i % 251 for i in range(129))
mac = [(n, hmac.new(bytes(i % 251 for i in range(n)), message, 'sha256').hexdigest())
       for n in [0,1,32,63,64,65,131]]
source = Path('crates/charlotte-launch/tests/sha256.rs').read_text()
for _, digest in sha + mac:
    assert digest in source, digest
print('All 23 checked-in SHA/HMAC vectors match independent Python hashlib/hmac.')
print(json.dumps({'sha256':sha,'hmac_sha256':mac},indent=2))
